FINAL ANSWER: The odds ratio for p53-mediated cell cycle regulation in the Reactome_2022-style enrichment of statistically differentially expressed genes (padj<0.05, |log2FC|>0.5, baseMean>10) between the CBD/cisplatin combination (Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50, Group 9) and DMSO (Group 3) is OR = 14.73 (14.7255).

Reported with explicit caveats (documented offline deviations):

1) Groups: Group 9 (n=3) vs Group 3 (n=3); Group 10 (combination + serum starvation) excluded as confounded. DE was a from-scratch DESeq2-style negative-binomial GLM (median-of-ratios size factors, method-of-moments dispersion + parametric trend, Wald log2FC, BH padj) because the offline runner has no gseapy/pydeseq2/R and no network.
2) Enrichment: computed with the Enrichr-equivalent ORA formula OR=(a*d)/(b*c) over the DEG list (same definition as gseapy.enrichr's Odds Ratio column), background = all mapped prefilter-passing genes.
3) Gene set: the Reactome_2022 library could not be downloaded (no network), so the 'p53 Mediated Cell Cycle Regulation' term was reconstructed as a best-faith canonical 23-gene TP53 cell-cycle/effector target set (CDKN1A, MDM2, MDM4, GADD45A/B/G, RRM2B, BAX, BBC3, PMAIP1, CCNG1/2, BTG2, DDB2, ZMAT3, TP53INP1, FAS, CASP3, SFN, SESN1/2, PPM1D, PLK3); all 23 present in background.

Result summary:
* Tested genes (prefiltered, total>0 over 30 samples): 35,723; mapped background Nb=32,534.
* DEGs after filter: 1,731 (ENSG-level) -> 1,624 with unique mapped gene names (105 unmapped dropped); 921 up / 810 down in the combination.
* Gene set: K=23 (in background); DEG overlap x=10 -> a=10, b=1614, c=13, d=30897, OR=(10*30897)/(1614*13)=14.7255; hypergeometric/Fisher right-p=5.9e-08.
* DEG members: BAX, BTG2, CCNG2, CDKN1A, DDB2, FAS, PLK3, RRM2B, TP53INP1, ZMAT3.
* Sensitivity (single-member membership perturbations): OR ranges ~13.2 (dropping one DEG member) to ~16.2 (adding an additional DEG target such as CCNE1/AEN/SERPINE1); adding a non-DEG member gives ~13.7. Baseline reconstruction OR = 14.73.
